sources.description: September 17, 2025 - Ranking Member Jamie Raskin and Judiciary Democrats documented Kash Patel's refusal to release Epstein files, blocking subpoenas for bank CEOs and Bongino testimony, and gutting the FBI's anti-corruption and counterterrorism units.
sources.label: House Judiciary Committee Democrats - Under Director Kash Patel, FBI Is Covering Up Trump's Relationship with Epstein

sources.description: February 11, 2025 - Senate floor speech revealing whistleblower allegations that Patel, as a private citizen awaiting confirmation, was directing FBI purges through Stephen Miller and Acting Deputy AG Bove. Durbin requested DOJ IG investigation.
sources.label: Sen. Dick Durbin - Kash Patel Has Been Personally Directing The Ongoing Purge Of FBI Officials

sources.description: February 7, 2025 - Investigation revealing Patel owns $1-5 million in stock from Elite Depot, the Cayman Islands parent company of Shein. Patel received RSUs for consulting services starting April 2024, the same month Shein hired a lobbying firm where Pam Bondi worked.
sources.label: WIRED - Trump's FBI Pick Kash Patel Took Up to $5M in Stock From Chinese Ecommerce Giant Shein

sources.description: January 29, 2025 - CREW letter arguing Patel is unqualified to lead FBI due to slim executive branch experience, limited federal law enforcement experience, and stated desire to use FBI to seek retribution against political rivals.
sources.label: CREW - Senate Should Reject Patel's Nomination for FBI Director

sources.description: December 1, 2025 - Raskin and Kamlager-Dove exposed Patel's abuse of $60-62 million FBI Gulfstream G550 for date nights with girlfriend, golf trips to Scotland, and luxury hunting retreat during Republican shutdown. Patel fired 27-year FBI veteran Steven Palmer when misuse became public.
sources.label: House Judiciary Committee Democrats - Demand FBI Director Kash Patel Reimburse Taxpayers After Using Government Jet for Personal Flights, Lavish Vacations, and Romantic Date Nights

sources.description: June 27, 2025 - Coons confronted Patel about politically-motivated firings of FBI agents who worked on January 6 cases and whether disciplinary actions were taken against those agents.
sources.label: Sen. Chris Coons - Grills FBI Director Kash Patel Over Firing of FBI Officers for January 6 Investigations

sources.description: February 20, 2025 - Durbin statement noting he voted for four Republican FBI directors before but could not vote for Patel due to lack of experience, judgment, and temperament to lead the FBI.
sources.label: Sen. Dick Durbin - Kash Patel's Record Shows He Is A Dangerous, Inexperienced, & Dishonest Trump Loyalist Who Is Not Qualified To Serve As Next FBI Director
